gate.title: Settings are for admins
gate.body: Sign in with the admin password to check game updates and manage the tool.

title: Game updates
subtitle: The tool's data (Codex, skills, Bestiary, exploration book and art) comes straight from the game. A robot checks for a new game version every day at 06:23 and publishes the update on its own if every test passes.
outdatedHint: Press Update now, or wait for tomorrow's automatic check.
updateHint: Downloads the game, rebuilds the data and publishes it if tests pass (about 2-4 minutes, plus Vercel's deploy).
githubMissing: The GitHub token is not set up yet (GITHUB_UPDATE_TOKEN in Vercel): the button stays off, but the daily robot still runs.
rollback: Each update is its own commit on main. To undo one, revert that commit on GitHub (or ask Claude) and Vercel publishes the previous version again.

history.title: What changed
history.empty: No updates recorded yet: the first one appears when the game changes.

errors.github_not_configured: The GitHub token is not set up (GITHUB_UPDATE_TOKEN).
errors.github_forbidden: GitHub rejected the token: check that it has Actions read and write permission on the repository.
errors.github_not_found: GitHub could not find the robot (is the workflow on main?).
errors.github_error: GitHub did not answer. Try again in a moment.
